infinity.family: a^n b^n against every DFA, every number of states k
infinity.reduction: Myhill-Nerode / pumping: among a^0..a^k two prefixes a^i, a^j (i < j <= k) reach the same state, so a^i b^i and a^j b^i get the same verdict, but exactly one is in a^n b^n; a disagreement of length i + j <= 2k - 1. Written in math/language/BASE.md; exhaustive for k <= 3
